Valued Warwickshire equality and diversity charity celebrates 10-year milestone

Andy Morris 11th Oct, 2026   0 Comments
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:16
Instaread

A VALUED Warwickshire equality and diversity charity has celebrated a 10-year milestone.

The Equality and Inclusion Partnership (EQuIP) is celebrating a decade since it was established as the county’s equality and diversity charity – a key landmark in its role supporting Warwickshire residents over the last 25 years.

Chief Executive Junaid Hussain said he was delighted to have been able to celebrate the anniversary with friends of the charity.

He said: “EQuIP was established as a charitable organisation on September 30, 2016 and it is fitting to celebrate our 10th birthday.

“EQuIP was established to develop the work of its predecessors – the Racial Equality Councils in Warwick and Rugby, and their successor, the Warwickshire Race Equality Partnership, which was established in 2005 as a joint venture between Warwickshire County Council, all district and borough councils, Warwickshire Police and Warwickshire Probation Service, building on those roots over many decades.

“I am honoured to be the Chief Executive of such an organisation, and on behalf of trustees current and past, staff and volunteers, thank you to everyone who has supported us over the years.


“The need for an independent equalities organisation offering free confidential advice and support to diverse communities, tackling fairness and ensuring everyone gets treated equitably when accessing services, housing, employment or healthcare, is ever more needed.”

Chair of Trustees Kailash Mistry said EQuIP did not ‘simply appear’ in 2016.

He added: “It was built on decades of race equality and community relations work and on the efforts of people who recognised that discrimination had to be challenged and that communities were stronger when everybody had an opportunity to participate.

“In 2016, the organisation took an important step and developed into the Equality and Inclusion Partnership – an organisation committed to promoting equality across all protected groups.

“Someone may experience disadvantage because of their age, race, disability, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity – or because several of those things intersect.

“EQuIP recognises that if we believe in equality, it has to mean equality for everybody.

“We are delighted to celebrate EQuIP, its history of service to the people of Warwickshire and look forward to our future continuing to serve all of our communities.”
